title: The Six Swans (The Star-Flower Shirts)
summary: Sewing shirts of star-flowers in unbroken silence for six years, the devoted sister endured false accusations and the stake itself to break the curse upon her brothers....
full_text:
Sewing shirts of star-flowers in unbroken silence for six years, the devoted sister endured false accusations and the stake itself to break the curse upon her brothers.

The wild swans swooped from the clouds, took their human forms, and proclaimed her royal innocence to the rejoicing realm.
moral: Silent devotion weaves the fabric of salvation for brothers lost in enchantment.

quiz.question: What is the central moral lesson taught in "The Six Swans variant"?
options: Presence of mind and quiet wisdom triumph over brute strength.
Acting in haste and anger without thinking
Believing rumors and flattery without proof
quiz.hint: Remember the moral lesson of this traditional story.

quiz.question: How do the characters overcome their challenge?
options: Through patience, calm reflection, and wisdom
By shouting loudly and blaming others
By running away from every problem
quiz.hint: Consider the virtues praised in world folklore.

quiz.question: What memorable conclusion does this story teach young readers?
options: Honesty, kindness, and clear thinking lead to peace
quiz.hint: Reflect upon the resolution of the story.
